dialogues.title: Checking in
dialogues.context: Otele vardın, rezervasyonun var. Kahvaltı ve Wi-Fi bilgilerini de öğreneceksin.

lines.en: Good afternoon, welcome. Checking in?
lines.tr: İyi günler, hoş geldiniz. Giriş mi yapacaksınız?
alternatives: Afternoon! Are you checking in?

lines.en: Yes, I have a reservation under Kaya.
alternatives: I am — it should be under Kaya.

lines.en: Let me find that for you. Two nights, is that right?
lines.tr: Hemen bakıyorum. İki gece, doğru mu?
alternatives: One moment... two nights, correct?

lines.en: That's right.
alternatives: Yes, exactly.

lines.en: Could I see your passport, please?
alternatives: May I have some ID?

lines.en: Here you are. Is breakfast included?
alternatives: Sure, here. Does the rate include breakfast?

lines.en: It is — seven to ten, in the lobby restaurant.
lines.tr: Dahil, yediden ona kadar, lobi restoranında.
alternatives: Yes, downstairs from seven until ten.

lines.en: Great. What's the Wi-Fi password?
alternatives: Perfect. And the Wi-Fi code?

lines.en: It's on the back of your key card.
alternatives: You'll find it on your key card.

lines.en: And what time is check-out?
alternatives: When do we need to check out?

lines.en: Eleven, but we can hold your bags after that.
lines.tr: On birde, ama sonrasında bavullarınızı tutabiliriz.
alternatives: Eleven — and we're happy to store your luggage.

lines.en: That's very kind of you. Room number?
alternatives: Good to know, thanks. Which room am I in?

lines.en: Room 304, third floor. Enjoy your stay.
alternatives: You're in 304 — enjoy your stay!

dialogues.title: A problem with the room
dialogues.context: Odana çıktın: klima çalışmıyor ve yan oda çok gürültülü. Resepsiyonu arıyorsun.

lines.en: Front desk, how can I help?
alternatives: Reception — what can I do for you?

lines.en: Hi, this is room 304. The air conditioning isn't working.
alternatives: Hello, room 304 — the AC won't turn on.

lines.en: I'm sorry about that. Have you tried the panel by the door?
lines.tr: Bunun için özür dilerim. Kapının yanındaki paneli denediniz mi?
alternatives: Sorry to hear it. There's a switch by the door — did you try that?

lines.en: I did, nothing happens.
alternatives: Yes, but nothing's happening.

lines.en: I'll send someone up right away.
alternatives: I'll have maintenance come up now.

lines.en: Thanks. There's one more thing.
alternatives: Appreciate it. Also, sorry — one other thing.

lines.en: The room next door is really loud.
alternatives: It's very noisy next door.

lines.en: I'm sorry — I'll give them a call.
alternatives: My apologies. I'll speak with them.

lines.en: If it keeps up, could I change rooms?
alternatives: And if it continues, is another room possible?

lines.en: Of course. We have a quiet one at the back.
lines.tr: Elbette. Arka tarafta sessiz bir odamız var.
alternatives: Certainly — there's a quieter room at the rear.

lines.en: That would be great, actually. Could we do that now?
lines.tr: Aslında bu harika olur. Şimdi yapabilir miyiz?
alternatives: I'd prefer that, if it's not too much trouble.

lines.en: Absolutely. Come down and I'll swap your key card.
alternatives: No problem at all — come down for a new key.

dialogues.title: Checking out
dialogues.context: Ayrılıyorsun. Hesapta tanımadığın bir kalem var, ayrıca akşam uçuşuna kadar bavulunu bırakmak istiyorsun.

lines.en: Good morning. Checking out?
alternatives: Morning! Are you checking out today?

lines.en: Yes, room 304.
alternatives: I am — room 304.

lines.en: Here's your bill. Everything look alright?
lines.tr: Hesabınız. Her şey doğru görünüyor mu?
alternatives: Your invoice — does it all look correct?

lines.en: I think there's a mistake on the bill.
alternatives: Sorry, I think something's wrong here.

lines.en: Let me have a look. Which item?
alternatives: Let me check — which line?

lines.en: The minibar. I didn't use it.
alternatives: This minibar charge — that wasn't me.

lines.en: You're right, that's from the previous guest. My apologies.
lines.tr: Haklısınız, önceki misafirden kalmış. Özür dilerim.
alternatives: I see it — wrong room. Sorry about that.

lines.en: No worries.
alternatives: Don't worry about it.

lines.en: I've removed it. The total is two-forty.
alternatives: Taken off — that brings you to two hundred forty.

lines.en: Could you hold my bags until three?
alternatives: Can I leave my luggage here until this afternoon?

lines.en: Of course. Here's your tag.
alternatives: No problem — keep this tag.

lines.en: We had a great stay, thank you.
lines.tr: Çok güzel bir konaklama oldu, teşekkürler.
alternatives: It was a lovely stay — thanks for everything.

lines.en: Thank you. We hope to see you again.
alternatives: Our pleasure — come back soon!
